name: Buchholz in der Nordheide (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Buchholz in der Nordheide (crossed horse's heads and a beech twig on blue and yellow above a brick wall).
history: Municipal flag of Buchholz in der Nordheide; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Buchholz arms — horse's heads, beech twig and wall
